exam.title: Designing and Implementing Multi-Agent AI Solutions
exam.study_prerequisites: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), plus production Python, Azure compute/network/storage/data, Microsoft Foundry, agent frameworks, MCP, RAG, identity, security, evaluation, observability, and CI/CD experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Evaluate, optimize, and monitor multi-agent solutions
Secure, govern, and deploy multi-agent solutions

review.notes: Every subobjective on the official study-guide page last updated July 16, 2026 is mapped to an architecture, implementation, evaluation, operating, security, governance, or release decision. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original knowledge checks cover decomposition and topology, Agent Framework and HITL, MCP/A2A, per-agent identity and OBO, multi-tier memory and RAG, prompt/context/fine-tuning choices, tools and middleware, evaluation, continuity, tracing, cost, guardrails, red teaming, and deployment. All 34 cited URLs are cataloged: 32 reachable and two commercial pages access-blocked. The September 7 watch records the October GA target without inventing a date and documents the hosted-agent migration boundary while retaining verified beta status.

findings.title: Beta and future course availability remain separate
findings.evidence: Current exam beta, English, AI-103 prerequisite; course lists September 30; no assessment.
findings.recommendation: Retain status and schedule course/beta follow-ups; no fixed duration or exact GA date.
findings.resolution: Retain status and schedule course/beta follow-ups; no fixed duration or exact GA date.

findings.title: Initial hosted backend support deadline has passed
findings.evidence: Initial preview supported only through August 20; no automatic migration.
findings.recommendation: Add current protocol packages, SDK/CLI, endpoint/configuration and redeployment boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add current protocol packages, SDK/CLI, endpoint/configuration and redeployment boundaries.

findings.title: Classic inference and Assistants deadlines have passed
findings.evidence: Migration lists August 26 sunsets and current Responses path.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish generation, SDK and API version axes; validate regions/state separately.
findings.resolution: Distinguish generation, SDK and API version axes; validate regions/state separately.

findings.title: Legacy publication identity differs from current deployment identity
findings.evidence: Legacy Agent Application section describes old shared draft identity; current hosted agents get identity at creation.
findings.recommendation: Scope both descriptions and grant downstream access to the current agent identity.
findings.resolution: Scope both descriptions and grant downstream access to the current agent identity.

findings.title: A2A GA does not change the unversioned default
findings.evidence: GA 1.0 coexists with preview 0.3 default; auth, retention and transport limits apply.
findings.recommendation: Replace blanket preview statement with explicit version/auth/capability contract.
findings.resolution: Replace blanket preview statement with explicit version/auth/capability contract.

findings.title: Gateway MCP support is narrower than generic MCP
findings.evidence: Tools-only, workspace and listed-tier limits apply.
findings.recommendation: Separate inbound/outbound authorization and unsupported MCP features.
findings.resolution: Separate inbound/outbound authorization and unsupported MCP features.

findings.title: Server-side post-filtering is not equivalent to a prompt leak
findings.evidence: Search post-filter modes can enforce scope but lose eligible candidates.
findings.recommendation: Correct memory, retrieval and answer 13; add candidate-set example.
findings.resolution: Correct memory, retrieval and answer 13; add candidate-set example.

findings.title: Checkpoint scope is not authenticated ownership
findings.evidence: Thread checkpoints and cross-thread stores have different lifecycles; in-memory savers are not durable.
findings.recommendation: Add trusted tenant/subject binding, lifecycle and memory-scope checks.
findings.resolution: Add trusted tenant/subject binding, lifecycle and memory-scope checks.

findings.title: Resume can repeat work from the start of a node
findings.evidence: Interrupt restart semantics and side-effect retries require explicit idempotency.
findings.recommendation: Add original offline deduplication example, production limits and failure-point lab.
findings.resolution: Add original offline deduplication example, production limits and failure-point lab.

findings.title: A local model component still needs an implementation contract
findings.evidence: Task/revision/remote-code/batching settings affect reproducibility and execution.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded specialist design and optional lab without untested SDK sample claims.
findings.resolution: Add bounded specialist design and optional lab without untested SDK sample claims.

findings.title: Stored-output evaluation does not re-run deployment behavior
findings.evidence: Portal supports distinct agent/model and dataset evaluation targets.
findings.recommendation: Separate conversation/turn and stored-output evidence; add critical-slice release example.
findings.resolution: Separate conversation/turn and stored-output evidence; add critical-slice release example.

findings.title: Operational success is not business correctness
findings.evidence: Run completion metrics, sampled evaluation, connected telemetry and preview settings differ.
findings.recommendation: Add outcome-cost example and retention/SLA/preview boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add outcome-cost example and retention/SLA/preview boundaries.

findings.title: Tool moderation does not run for unsupported tools
findings.evidence: Tool-call/response controls require listed tool support.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit coverage matrix and separate companion authorization controls.
findings.resolution: Add explicit coverage matrix and separate companion authorization controls.

findings.title: Red-team support differs from moderation support
findings.evidence: Target/tool matrix excludes workflows and several tool paths.
findings.recommendation: Add separate coverage/untested labels and synthetic-data isolation limits.
findings.resolution: Add separate coverage/untested labels and synthetic-data isolation limits.

findings.title: Recent resilient hosting guidance motivates recovery practice
findings.evidence: September 24 article describes checkpoints, stable IDs and application-owned external idempotency.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded restart worksheet; do not adopt performance or execution claims.
findings.resolution: Add bounded restart worksheet; do not adopt performance or execution claims.

findings.title: Preview memory extraction has lifecycle and scope limits
findings.evidence: July 24 provider article describes async derived memory and cross-thread user scope.
findings.recommendation: Add original lag/correction/deletion/isolation exercise with authenticated scope.
findings.resolution: Add original lag/correction/deletion/isolation exercise with authenticated scope.

findings.title: Current preparation evidence differs from old runtime totals
findings.evidence: Current Learn paths expose 17 modules; blocked book/Udemy and public outlines differ in evidentiary strength.
findings.recommendation: Qualify durations, seller update claim and catalog gaps; synchronize central catalog.
findings.resolution: Qualify durations, seller update claim and catalog gaps; synchronize central catalog.

blog_intake.author: Dan Taylor
blog_intake.notes: Recovery and async-memory worksheet; external-effect idempotency separate from checkpoints. No SDK/hosting or benchmark reproduction.

blog_intake.author: Theo van Kraay
blog_intake.notes: Preview memory provider design exercise with authenticated scope, extraction lag and correction/deletion; no resource or model execution.

offline_checks: Nineteen assertions: 15 critical-path/quota/context/filter/scope/evaluation/cost/catalog assertions and four assertions executing the guide standard-library replay example. No cloud or framework execution.

limitations: No Azure/Foundry/APIM/Cosmos resource, identity/policy, SDK/framework, model/weights, live tool, migration or cloud lab executed.
Offline replay uses an in-memory single-process fake service; no durable storage, concurrency, real crash or production exactly-once behavior verified.
Book and Udemy requests access-blocked; indexed catalog descriptions do not verify paid content, originality or coverage. Course remains future and Learn duration totals not exposed.
Certification announcement returned HTTP 200 content shell; October target treated as historical. Generic large retained references refreshed without exhaustive content/code audit.
Two blog main articles read; linked code/videos, benchmarks and deployment behavior not reproduced.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent human review pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
